summary: The change adds a payee lookup and includes the account_number in the error log for statement-delivery failures in deliver_statement. The account_number is an NPI field, but the AppLog layer masks all NPI fields before writing, as confirmed by the passing logging control tests in CI. The change is governed by a properly approved standard ticket (CHG-26026) with a qualifying independent code_review approval from a different person on the same team. The CI run on the head commit passes all 172 tests including every registered control test, and the changed file is neither security-sensitive nor in a protected path. No existing evidence lapses. All applicable product and process obligations are satisfied.
